verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs describe defining SLOs and getting alerts when the SLO budget is threatened [docs-7]. They also cover Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs for error budgets [docs-22] and SLO burn alerts routed to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams or webhooks [docs-8, docs-33], with SLOs manageable via the API [docs-27]. missing for 10: detailed documentation of burn-rate alert configuration (windows, thresholds, alert types), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SLO workflow.
